thread:
lina: Quick report: the Next hybrid starter (SSR + edge API) reproduces a streaming hang when ephemeral tokens rotate mid-stream.

vik: Can you describe the flow?

lina: Edge route does ephemeral exchange then calls the JS SDK to open a stream. If the token TTL expires and our refresh runs, the SDK retry replays the stream but uses the old token value. Result: client waits forever.

oscar: Which SDK version? This sounds like an auth resolution timing bug.

lina: @vik updated template to @redwood/sdk@0.9.2. Node runtime on Vercel edge. Python client behaves fine (resolves auth per retry). JS client seems to reuse the header.

vik: Minimal repro snippet from the starter: 

```
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const ephemeral = await getToken(req.cookies.session);
  const s = await redwood.stream({ model: 'redwood/fast-13b', prompt: req.body.prompt, token: ephemeral });
  s.pipe(res);
}
```

oscar: Logs?

lina: Logs show token rotated then retry used old token: 
```
[2026-03-22T10:12:01Z] fetched token id=tmp1 ttl=25s
[2026-03-22T10:12:23Z] token rotated id=tmp2
[2026-03-22T10:12:24Z] retry attempt=1 Authorization: Bearer tmp1
[2026-03-22T10:12:24Z] stream stuck waiting for data
```

vik: Fix idea: allow client to accept an authResolver function that the SDK will call at each request/retry to fetch fresh headers.

oscar: Good. Also add test that simulates rotation mid-stream and assert Authorization header on retry equals newly-resolved token.

lina: Short-term workaround for devs: perform ephemeral exchange server-side and return a one-shot signed URL or have client fetch a fresh token right before calling streaming endpoint. Not ideal for demos.

vik: I'll prototype authResolver API in the JS client (option: { auth: async () => fetch('/api/ephemeral').then(r=>r.json()).token }). If tests pass, we'll patch 0.9.x and update the starter template and README note under "Edge auth patterns".

oscar: Please add a small example to the starter showing authResolver usage so new users don't hit this fragility.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/edge-auth-resolver  4 checks running.

lina: Thanks — I'll open the starter PR once the SDK change lands. If anyone has other ephemeral token flows (cookies, custom KMS) share repros here.

oscar: Filing a client issue and test PR today.

lina: :thumbsup:
